This piece of functional art is here to remind you that no matter how gloopy and messy life gets, there is always love and joy bursting through. 🌈💗 I am so excited to finally start sharing the first pieces from my 2026 collection! The first half of this year has been full of learning, experimenting, and pushing my work in new directions. It has also been one of the heaviest seasons of my life. While making this collection, I found myself returning again and again to the same idea: choosing hope. This piece feels like a little celebration of that. A reminder that even when things feel overwhelming, beautiful things can still emerge from the mess. Thankfully, the scary chapter my chosen family has been living through is coming to a very happy ending, and I am sitting in deep gratitude for that. Not everyone gets that outcome, and I don’t take it for granted for a second. So tell me, what makes you stay hopeful when life feels extra gloopy? #ceramicartist #dopaminedecor #glitterinlay #rainbowart #processvideo

A simple way to add a lock to a regular flat lid. This locking system is made entirely from clay and keeps the lid in place without changing the look of the piece. I love simple solutions like this - especially when they disappear into the design. I prefer to fire the lid upside down, standing on the knob. This allows me to apply a thin layer of glaze to the bottom of the lid, the locking tabs, and the gallery, creating a smoother, more cohesive look when the piece is open. #pottery #ceramics

This episode of The Business of Pottery is actually brought to you by buttered noodles 🙃 These bowls aren’t the shape or size you picture of when you hear “pasta bowls,” they aren’t huge and you’re probably like “I def need more pasta than that”. When I brought the first one home I definitely didn’t think it was big enough HOWEVER, they fit the EXACT amount of buttered noodles to get me full! I’m talking about your mid-day bowl of buttered noodles or Mac and Cheese when you need something quick, not tooooo much, just enough to feel satisfied, but not enough to weigh you down. It’s the perfect size!  #pottery #ceramics #arttok #fulltimeartist

Maybe part of my own practice right now is learning to care less about Western institutional validation. I can take myself seriously as an artist without believing that a gallery, residency, MFA, collector, or critic makes my work inherently more important than someone making extraordinary pots as their everyday trade. Pottery is ancient, global, utilitarian, and deeply humble. I think a lot of us could stand to remember that.  #pottery #ceramics #wheelthrowing

Here’s a completed apothecary jar and a full overview of how it’s made. For this type of lidded jar, the base and lid are thrown from one continuous piece of clay, then cut open and trimmed to create the inner edges and gallery so the lid doesn’t slide off. I like this type of piece because it has a continuous line from the base to the top of the knob. It’s a very elegant shape and one I imagine would look lovely on a shelf holding trinkets, spices, or chocolates. #pottery #studioceramics #wheelthrown #handmade #potteryartist
